lead: A frozen `--EXPECTF-ERROR--` block's line numbers are read off the runner, not counted by hand.
body: `--FILE--`'s first line, the `<?nvs`, is *not* `case.nvs:1` — the line after it is, so the number is the `.nvst` line minus one more than the header, and an off-by-one lands the caret on the statement above the one that is wrong. Write the block with any plausible numbers and run `target/debug/nvs test tests/conformance/core --filter <slug>` once — it prints the real `case.nvs:NN:CC` in the actual half, and columns do not shift with the header.
